title: [TERMUX-JOB] Prove frozen retirement with Debian dependency resolution and publish
body:
{"version":2,"confirm":"EXECUTE","id":"coverage-retirement-proof-debian-20261031-cf947","target":"termux","cwd":"~","timeout_seconds":900,"command":"set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'TDP_PROOF'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,tempfile,base64,os
repo='luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform'
base='d979b9813c1ab40b96dee64616b9f7d08a7c0d07'
head='e78f891eaea58ce850d154426420ea5e0c3dcdc1'
tree='98d1f5b4b861684ec6495d983e0d272ef4960d42'
branch='chore/retire-audit-coverage-renewal-20261031-222400-f25b97cd'
store=Path.home()/'repos/touristic-digital-platform.git'
def run(a,**kw):
 p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,**kw)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('COMMAND_FAILED:'+str(a[:3])+':'+p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-900:] if isinstance(p.stderr,bytes) else 'COMMAND_FAILED:'+str(a[:3]))
 return p.stdout
assert json.loads(run(['gh','api','repos/'+repo+'/commits/main'],text=True))['sha']==base
root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tdp-retirement-proof-',dir=Path.home()/'.cache'))
payload=json.loads(run(['gh','api','repos/'+repo+'/git/blobs/14af4c32b87cd56565fbf12a9d7c89f516c9ff9b'],text=True))
bundle=base64.b64decode(payload['content'])
assert len(bundle)==6771 and hashlib.sha256(bundle).hexdigest()=='4cf01dd154b864e665566864f64d15b0710bf176462795923aaec27bfc7e2d91'
(root/'candidate.bundle').write_bytes(bundle)
qa=root/'frozen-candidate'
run(['git','clone','--no-checkout','--shared',str(store),str(qa)])
run(['git','-C',str(qa),'bundle','verify',str(root/'candidate.bundle')])
run(['git','-C',str(qa),'fetch',str(root/'candidate.bundle'),'HEAD'])
assert run(['git','-C',str(qa),'rev-parse','FETCH_HEAD'],text=True).strip()==head
run(['git','-C',str(qa),'checkout','-b',branch,head])
run(['git','-C',str(qa),'remote','set-url','origin','https://github.com/'+repo+'.git'])
run(['git','-C',str(qa),'fetch','--no-tags','origin','+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'])
assert run(['git','-C',str(qa),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()==tree
assert not run(['git','-C',str(qa),'status','--porcelain=v1'],text=True).strip()
lock=hashlib.sha256((qa/'pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
discover_script=r"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,os,sys
qa=Path(sys.argv[1]);lock=sys.argv[2]
seed=None
roots=[Path(sys.argv[3])/'worktrees',Path('/root/worktrees')]
seen=set()
for r in roots:
 if not r.is_dir():continue
 for p in sorted(r.iterdir(),key=lambda p:p.name,reverse=True):
  if str(p) in seen:continue
  seen.add(str(p))
  try:
   if (p/'node_modules/.bin/prettier').exists() and (p/'node_modules/.bin/turbo').exists() and hashlib.sha256((p/'pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==lock:
    seed=p/'node_modules';break
  except OSError:pass
 if seed:break
if seed:
 (qa/'node_modules').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 for child in seed.iterdir():os.symlink(child,qa/'node_modules'/child.name,target_is_directory=child.is_dir())
print(json.dumps({'seed':str(seed) if seed else None,'scanned':len(seen)}))
"""
d=json.loads(run(['proot-distro','login','debian','--','python3','-c',discover_script,str(qa),lock,str(Path.home())],text=True))
seed=d['seed']
print(json.dumps({'dependencyDiscovery':d,'qa':str(qa)}),flush=True)
if seed is None:
 p=subprocess.run(['proot-distro','login','debian','--','bash','-c','cd "$1" && pnpm --filter . install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts','_',str(qa)],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
 print(p.stdout[-2500:],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:print(p.stderr[-2500:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
 seed='frozen-offline-root-install'
runner=root/'auth-proof.mjs'
runner.write_text("""import {runGithubAuthExec} from '""" + (qa/'tooling/workspace/github-auth-exec.mjs').as_uri() + """';
import fs from 'node:fs';
const root=process.argv[2], mode=process.argv[3], output=process.argv[4];
const result=runGithubAuthExec({runtime:'debian-proot',root,repository:'luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform',expectedHead:'e78f891eaea58ce850d154426420ea5e0c3dcdc1',expectedMain:'d979b9813c1ab40b96dee64616b9f7d08a7c0d07',command:'node',args:['tooling/ci/local-fast-gate.mjs',mode,'--base','d979b9813c1ab40b96dee64616b9f7d08a7c0d07'],timeoutMs:300000});
fs.writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({mode,exitCode:result.exitCode,runtime:result.runtime,stdout:result.stdout.slice(-5000),stderr:result.stderr.slice(-2500)}));
process.exitCode=result.exitCode;
""")
print(json.dumps({'kind':'FROZEN_CANDIDATE_QA','workspace':str(qa),'sourceHead':head,'tree':tree,'dependencySeed':str(seed),'purpose':'proof-only; no material editing, task migration, lease issuance, commit creation or deployment'}),flush=True)
for mode in ['--admission','--certify']:
 p=subprocess.run(['node',str(runner),str(qa),mode,str(root/(mode[2:]+'.json'))],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=510)
 print(p.stdout,flush=True)
 if p.returncode:
  print(p.stderr[-2500:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
assert not run(['git','-C',str(qa),'status','--porcelain=v1'],text=True).strip()
assert run(['git','-C',str(qa),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==head
assert json.loads(run(['gh','api','repos/'+repo+'/commits/main'],text=True))['sha']==base
remote=run(['git','-C',str(qa),'ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/'+branch],text=True).strip()
assert not remote,'BRANCH_ALREADY_EXISTS'
out=run(['git','-C',str(qa),'push','--force-with-lease=refs/heads/'+branch+':','origin',head+':refs/heads/'+branch],text=True)
readback=run(['git','-C',str(qa),'ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/'+branch],text=True).strip()
assert readback.split()[0]==head
print(json.dumps({'kind':'EXACT_FROZEN_RETIREMENT_PUBLISHED','head':head,'tree':tree,'branch':branch,'localAdmission':'PASS','localCertify':'PASS','readback':readback,'proofDirectory':str(root)}),flush=True)
TDP_PROOF
"}
